name: @sos-2/promotion
description: SOS 2.0 Promotion: the evidence-gated promotion/rollback gate — evaluatePromotion(candidate, { authority, assurance, evidence }) checks CURRENT authority (a valid, unexpired, unrevoked AuthorityGrant from @sos-2/authority — confidence is NOT authorization), CURRENT assurance (an AssuranceCase-shaped fixture input with claims, verdict and validity — NOT assumed valid; invalid, expired, superseded or violated cases block promotion) and CURRENT evidence (intervention-grade for causal claims, fresh, never simulated); decision outcomes are exactly the frozen six (ACT, EXPERIMENT, GATHER_EVIDENCE, ASK, REJECT, ROLLBACK) consumed from @sos-2/authority's frozen vocabulary; promotion records declare a BOUNDED recovery mechanism (a structural mirror of the unmerged W8 @sos-2/recovery-control contract) with rollback triggers wired to @sos-2/experiments guardrail trigger records (Work Order W9, parallel slot C; requirements R13, R14, R15; spec/architecture.md §13, §14).
